svg.title: An envelope U at least heat bounds each endpoint color coordinate, and aperture is at most one. For coordinate first-correction size M, | qfirste | ≤dim(Color)UM, including dormant zeros. Write Rc = dim(Color), dpay = distPay(η, r, Q, m, B) and Merr = Qdpay. Entry bounds are Merr for discrepancy and Q for terminal plate. Summing its n + 1 intermediate color indices, with the source’s extra convenient color factor, bounds each block-product entry by Rn+2 c QMn+1 err . Endpoint sums then give | chain | ≤1 2U2Rn+4 c QMn+1 err = centreQ(U) etaSn,
